title: A Glimpse into our Viralipurath Family History

description.para_1: This note marks the culmination of a journey through the historical pages of the Viralipurath family. Our story begins in the picturesque village of Mookkuthala, located in the Ponnani Taluk of Malappuram...
description.para_2: Surrounded by beautiful rivers and backwaters, this village is a hub of culture, education, and sports.
description.para_3: The Viralipurath family has been an integral part of this land's history, contributing significantly to its agricultural prosperity and social prestige. The family's contributions to the growth of this land, especially through its rich agricultural heritage, are beyond words.
description.para_4: The idea of a Viralipurath Family Meet finds its origin in the lineage of Late Moideenkutty. Originally a member of the Anthuriyil family in Maranchery, he settled in Mookkuthala, Moochikadavu area on a piece of land known as Viralipurath Parambu.
description.para_5: Kunju Sahib, Mammi Sahib, Muhammed Kutty and Amina were his four children.

message: "We don't just inherit a name; we inherit a responsibility to do good."
